requirements:
# Rancher requirements.txt
rancher
kubernetes
flask
pytest
urllib3
werkzeug
requests
jinja2
pyyaml
dockerfile:
# Rancher Dockerfile
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

EXPOSE 80

CMD ["python", "app.py"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt includes all detected imports with pyyaml instead of yaml for PyPI compatibility. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, copies application code, exposes port 80 (default web port), and assumes main application file is app.py.
